endangerment.comment: Hla'alua (2517-sxr) = Critically Endangered (100 percent certain, based on the evidence available) (Even for those who are truly native of Lha’alua speakers, they almost always use Mandarin or Bunun in their daily life. The Lha’alua language is not actively spoken anymore. In other words, there is no active speech community of the Lha’alua language.) [Pan 2012](cldf:pan:12)
